# docshare

> Temporary file & image hosting for handing artifacts to LLMs/agents. Files
> auto-delete after 24 hours. Public endpoint: https://docs.safzan.dev

docshare is an open Cloudflare Worker that gives any agent a short-lived
download URL for any file (≤400 MB) or any image (auto-converted to WebP, with
optional OCR via Gemini). Built for sharing build artifacts, screenshots, logs,
and documents with coding agents.

Source: https://github.com/safzanpirani/docshare

## Quickstart (one curl, ≤100 MB)

```bash
curl -T myfile.pdf https://docs.safzan.dev/upload/myfile.pdf
```

Response body is the download URL on stdout. Hand that URL to any tool — it
streams the original file with the original filename.

For files >100 MB, use the 3-step presigned flow (the Worker request body is
capped at 100 MB on Cloudflare Free/Pro; direct-to-R2 presigned PUT bypasses
that limit up to 400 MB).

## Agent skill

Install via [`vercel-labs/skills`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):

```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/safzanpirani/docshare
```

The agent then has a `docshare` skill that takes a local file path and returns
the share URL. Works with Claude Code, opencode, and the other agents the
`skills` package supports.

## API

- [PUT /upload/:filename](https://docs.safzan.dev/upload/) — simple one-shot
  upload, ≤100 MB. Body: raw file bytes. Response: plain-text download URL.
- [POST /api/upload](https://docs.safzan.dev/api/upload) — image upload, body
  must be `image/webp` bytes (≤15 MB). Returns JSON `{id, url, uploadedAt,
  expiresAt, size}`.
- [POST /api/doc/presign](https://docs.safzan.dev/api/doc/presign) — step 1 of
  3 for large docs. Body: `{filename, size, contentType}`. Returns `{id,
  putUrl, downloadUrl, uploadedAt, expiresAt, size}`. PUT the file bytes
  directly to `putUrl` (a presigned R2 S3 URL), then POST to /api/doc/finalize.
- [POST /api/doc/finalize](https://docs.safzan.dev/api/doc/finalize) — step 3.
  Body: `{id}`. Confirms the upload landed and enforces max size.
- [GET /d/:id/:filename](https://docs.safzan.dev/d/) — fetch a doc. Programmatic
  clients (curl/agents, no `text/html` in `Accept`) get the raw bytes as a forced
  download (`Content-Disposition: attachment` + `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`).
  Browsers get a rendered viewer: Markdown and `.txt` rendered, code/data
  syntax-highlighted (Rendered⇄Source toggle), PDFs previewed inline, media
  played inline. `?raw=1` forces raw text/bytes; `?dl=1` forces a download.
  Response sends `Vary: Accept`.
- [GET /i/:id.webp](https://docs.safzan.dev/i/) — fetch an image.
- [POST /api/ocr/:id](https://docs.safzan.dev/api/ocr/) — run OCR on an image
  (Gemini). Result cached server-side; second call on same image is free.
- [GET /api/info/:id](https://docs.safzan.dev/api/info/) — metadata for either
  an image or a doc.

## Limits

- 400 MB max per doc; 15 MB max per image
- 10 docs / 1.5 GB per IP per day (sustained); 2 doc uploads per 60 s (burst)
- 6 image uploads per 60 s, 3 OCR calls per 60 s
- All uploads auto-deleted after 24 h via R2 lifecycle rule

## What this is deliberately not

- Authenticated or account-based — anyone on the internet can upload
- Long-term storage (24 h TTL is hard)
- A general CDN — designed for short-lived agent handoffs
